GET /zones/{zone_identifier}/analytics/c.description: This view provides a breakdown of analytics data by datacenter. Note: This is available to Enterprise customers only.

schema.description: The (exclusive) end of the requested time frame. This value can be a negative integer representing the number of minutes in the past relative to time the request is made, or can be an absolute timestamp that conforms to RFC 3339. If omitted, the time of the request is used.

The (inclusive) beginning of the requested time frame. This value can be a negative integer representing the number of minutes in the past relative to time the request is made, or can be an absolute timestamp that conforms to RFC 3339. At this point in time, it cannot exceed a time in the past greater than one year.

Ranges that the Cloudflare web application provides will provide the following period length for each point:
- Last 60 minutes (from -59 to -1): 1 minute resolution
- Last 7 hours (from -419 to -60): 15 minutes resolution
- Last 15 hours (from -899 to -420): 30 minutes resolution
- Last 72 hours (from -4320 to -900): 1 hour resolution
- Older than 3 days (-525600 to -4320): 1 day resolution.

When set to true, the API will move the requested time window backward, until it finds a region with completely aggregated data.

The API response _may not represent the requested time window_.

cached.description: Total number of cached requests served.

content_type.description: A variable list of key/value pairs where the key represents the type of content served, and the value is the number of requests.

country.description: A variable list of key/value pairs where the key is a two-digit country code and the value is the number of requests served to that country.

http_status.description: Key/value pairs where the key is a HTTP status code and the value is the number of requests served with that code.

ssl.description: A break down of requests served over HTTPS.

encrypted.description: The number of requests served over HTTPS.

unencrypted.description: The number of requests served over HTTP.

ssl_protocols.description: A breakdown of requests by their SSL protocol.

TLSv1.description: The number of requests served over TLS v1.0.

TLSv1.1.description: The number of requests served over TLS v1.1.

TLSv1.2.description: The number of requests served over TLS v1.2.

TLSv1.3.description: The number of requests served over TLS v1.3.

none.description: The number of requests served over HTTP.

uncached.description: Total number of requests served from the origin.

since.description:
The (inclusive) beginning of the requested time frame. This value can be a negative integer representing the number of minutes in the past relative to time the request is made, or can be an absolute timestamp that conforms to RFC 3339. At this point in time, it cannot exceed a time in the past greater than one year.

Ranges that the Cloudflare web application provides will provide the following period length for each point:
- Last 60 minutes (from -59 to -1): 1 minute resolution
- Last 7 hours (from -419 to -60): 15 minutes resolution
- Last 15 hours (from -899 to -420): 30 minutes resolution
- Last 72 hours (from -4320 to -900): 1 hour resolution
- Older than 3 days (-525600 to -4320): 1 day resolution.

all.description: The total number of identifiable threats received over the time frame.

country.description: A list of key/value pairs where the key is a two-digit country code and the value is the number of malicious requests received from that country.

type.description: The list of key/value pairs where the key is a threat category and the value is the number of requests.

all.description: Total number of unique IP addresses within the time range.

until.description: The (exclusive) end of the requested time frame. This value can be a negative integer representing the number of minutes in the past relative to time the request is made, or can be an absolute timestamp that conforms to RFC 3339. If omitted, the time of the request is used.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful
